responsibility: Implements a collection of convenience wrappers around host C library and POSIX facilities for GNU Modula-2, including time-to-string formatting, file size and modification time queries, random-number selection, user-name lookup, UID/GID resolution, and `signbit` helpers. It serves as a miscellaneous host-utility layer with module init/fini hooks, complementing the more systematic libc and libm wrappers.
same_name_distinction: This is the implementation file in the Gwrapc pair: it provides the actual miscellaneous wrapper bodies for time strings, file metadata, random values, user lookup, and signbit helpers, plus module init/fini hooks, whereas gcc/m2/pge-boot/Gwrapc.h is only the public declaration surface for those utilities.
